improvements.title: State the expected result first
improvements.pattern: You often describe the change and add the real requirement only after the first answer.
improvements.impact: Several follow-ups in this sample start with a correction such as “no, keep the old API”.
improvements.suggestion: Put the expected result and the constraints in the first prompt.

evidence.quote: don't write code yet, break the plan into small steps

rewrite.after: Plan only, no code yet: break the change into small steps, list the risks of each, and keep the public API unchanged.

improvements.title: Name the file and the error
improvements.pattern: Debugging prompts rarely say which file or which error message.
improvements.impact: The AI has to ask or guess before it can help.
improvements.suggestion: Paste the error line and name the file and function in the same prompt.

improvements.title: 先講預期結果
improvements.pattern: 你常先描述要改什麼，等第一次回答後才補上真正的要求。
improvements.impact: 這份樣本裡有幾個追問是以糾正開頭，例如「不對，保留舊的 API」。
improvements.suggestion: 在第一個 prompt 就寫出預期結果和限制。

improvements.title: 指出檔案和錯誤訊息
improvements.pattern: 除錯的 prompt 很少說是哪個檔案、哪個錯誤。
improvements.impact: AI 必須先問或先猜，才能幫上忙。
improvements.suggestion: 同一個 prompt 裡貼上錯誤那一行，並寫出檔案和函式名稱。
